ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our net leverage ratio was 3.63:1.00 compared to the maximum permitted net leverage ratio of 4.25:1.00 for the quarter, and we were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement.

parsed.notes: Only the September 30, 2026 net leverage ratio is disclosed with an actual value. The interest coverage covenant (minimum 2.00:1.00 for periods after December 31, 2026) has no actual value disclosed. The minimum in force at September 30, 2026 is not stated, so no entry is given for it. The excerpt also describes future covenant step levels set by the Eleventh and Thirteenth Amendments: under the Thirteenth Amendment, 4.25x for Q1 2027, 4.00x for Q2 and Q3 2027 and through maturity. These are forward-looking limits, not measured ratios, so they are not listed as entries.
